title: Curmudgeon push-discipline reconciliation — authenticated clone + explicit end-of-run commit+push (restore PROP-101 cost telemetry, remove +1-day review→decider handoff latency)

problem.summary: curmudgeon.md is internally contradictory about whether curmudgeon pushes. Step 0 (curmudgeon.md:115) sets up an UNAUTHENTICATED clone with the comment 'unauthenticated is fine — curmudgeon only reads, doesn't push', and line 127 says 'write outputs to the workspace'. But the PROP-101 self-cost block (curmudgeon.md:542-548) appends the cost row to ${CLONE}/monitor/curmudgeon/cost-history.jsonl and states it 'rides along on the curmudgeon's normal commit+push' — a push the prompt never defines and the clone auth cannot perform. cost-history.jsonl is git-append-only (PROP-065), so workspace-sync will NEVER rescue it FUSE→git: the clone path is the ONLY path, and the prompt breaks it.
empirical_evidence: Through 2026-08-01 the model resolved the contradiction by improvising authenticated pushes: daily curmudgeon-authored commits exist (d2b50d0 2026-08-01 'curmudgeon: PROP-101 cost-history row (WIN-021.c5 run)', 3e5a403 07-29, 18b1652 07-28, 7981016 07-26, ... unbroken back through 06-14 PROP-101 landing). The PAT was available because the PROP-051 PRELUDE extracts $DOME_PAT at run start.

Since the post-outage restart (2026-08-09) the model reads the prompt literally: FUSE-only writes, zero pushes. Depth-50 git log (back to 08-10 03:47) contains commits from every other enabled agent but NOT ONE curmudgeon-authored commit.

Telemetry consequence: monitor/curmudgeon/cost-history.jsonl last row is 2026-08-01 (model claude-opus-4-8) while scheduled runs produced reviews on 08-09 (REACTIVE-AUDIT-2026-08-09), 08-10 (WIN-002.c6), 08-11 (PRED-072.c1), 08-12 (WIN-002.c7, FUSE-only as of this writing). PROP-101 aggregation is blind on one of the two Opus agents.

Latency consequence: reviews written ~01:12 UTC reach git only via the 04:00 UTC workspace-sync rescue commit (WIN-002.c6 via 38ccc58 'Workspace sync: 2026-08-10T04:09:05Z'; PRED-072.c1 via d0f6b2a 'Workspace sync: 2026-08-11T04:07:53Z'). The decider clones at 02:00 UTC — BEFORE the rescue — so digest-reviews.js misses every same-day review and processes it a full day late. ISS-3062 documents the near-miss: PRED-072.c1's real hole was only caught same-day because Step E2's queue-pop union-read happened to match queue_id 599.
problem.root_cause: Prompt-vs-behavior divergence. The de facto architecture (curmudgeon commits its own reviews + cost row) was never written into the prompt; it survived only as model improvisation. A model-behavior shift (post-outage restart; curmudgeon also moved opus-4-7 → opus-4-8 around 08-01) flipped the improvisation to literal compliance, and the undocumented behavior silently died. Same defect class as the workspace-sync Haiku improvisation history (2026-05-21): behavior that only exists in the model's judgment, not in the prompt, is not load-bearing.

part_a.old:
# Clone fresh from repo (unauthenticated is fine — curmudgeon only reads, doesn't push)
git clone --depth 50 https://github.com/funwithscience-org/dome-model-review.git ${CLONE} 2>/dev/null
part_a.new:
# Clone fresh AUTHENTICATED with $DOME_PAT from the PRELUDE (PROP-150): curmudgeon
# pushes its own review files + PROP-101 cost row at end of run (Step 9b). Through
# 2026-08-01 this push was model-improvised; PROP-150 makes it explicit after the
# 08-09..08-12 regression where literal prompt-reading silently killed telemetry
# and delayed every review's decider handoff by a day.
git clone --depth 50 "https://x-access-token:${DOME_PAT}@github.com/funwithscience-org/dome-model-review.git" ${CLONE} 2>/dev/null

part_b.anchor: immediately after the PROP-101 self-cost block (line ~548), as new step '9b. Commit + push run outputs (PROP-150)'
part_b.new_step_text:
### 9b. Commit + push run outputs (PROP-150)

From ${CLONE}, commit and push everything this run produced. EXPLICIT PATHS ONLY — never `git add -A` / `git add .` (mass-delete guard, 2026-05-21 lineage):

```bash
cd "${CLONE}"
git config user.name steve && git config user.email russelst@melrosecastle.com
git add monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/<each new review file written this run> \
        monitor/curmudgeon/cost-history.jsonl
# plus tracker.json / alerts.txt IF actually modified this run (explicit paths)
git pull --rebase origin main
git commit -m "curmudgeon <date>: <target>.c<N> review + PROP-101 cost row"
git push origin main
```

On push failure (403/network/rebase conflict): the review files are already dual-written to ${WORKSPACE}/monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/ (append-only dir — workspace-sync rescues within ≤8h), so review content is never lost. Do NOT write cost-history.jsonl to FUSE (git-append-only deny is load-bearing, PROP-065/FND-02); the cost row is accepted-lost for that run. Log the failure to stderr and end the run normally.

part_c.anchor: line ~127 ('In short: read data from the clone...')
part_c.old: In short: read data from the clone (guaranteed fresh), write outputs to the workspace (shared with other agents).
part_c.new: In short: read data from the clone (guaranteed fresh); write review outputs to BOTH the workspace (immediate cross-agent visibility on FUSE) AND the clone (committed+pushed at Step 9b so the 02:00 UTC decider sees same-day reviews and the PROP-101 cost row survives). The cost row is clone-only (PROP-065).

fix.explicitly_out_of_scope: No change to digest-reviews.js or decider.md. ISS-3062's suggested digest FUSE-union is REJECTED as the primary fix: it adds FUSE-read complexity at the consumer, does nothing for the dead cost telemetry, and still leaves reviews ~3h late in git. Decider Step E2's existing queue-pop union-read stays as belt-and-braces for the push-failure fallback path.

alternatives_considered.option: Digest FUSE-union in decider Priority 3 (ISS-3062 suggestion)
alternatives_considered.verdict: rejected as primary — treats the symptom at one consumer; telemetry stays dead; Step E2 union already covers the residual fallback window

alternatives_considered.option: Reclassify curmudgeon/cost-history.jsonl to allow FUSE→git rescue
alternatives_considered.verdict: rejected — weakens the FND-02 disaster-tested git-append-only deny for a telemetry file; wrong trade
rejected — PROP-101 blind on an Opus agent, +1d handoff latency on every curmudgeon review, and the contradiction re-bites on every future model change

risk_analysis.devilwench_403: Mitigated: PRELUDE scope-check runs before any git op; curmudgeon pushed daily 2026-06-14→2026-08-01 with zero 403 incidents; curmudgeon-verify pushes today (ebf0ab8, bafae4b).
risk_analysis.mass_delete_class: Curmudgeon's push surface is additive-only (new review files + one JSONL append + occasional tracker.json). Explicit-path git add is mandated in the step text; no deletes possible.
risk_analysis.concurrency: Curmudgeon (01:00 UTC) does not overlap decider (02:00) or workspace-sync (00/04/08); git pull --rebase before push handles the poller/analyst commits from 00:0x-01:4x.

verification_pattern.description: PASS when the newest curmudgeon cost-history row is younger than 72h (proves the clone-side append+push chain is alive again).

iss_closure_on_apply: ISS-3062 closes as resolved-by-PROP-150 (design question answered: fix at source, not at digest). The decider may close via normal PROP-apply flow.
operator_apply_notes: Prompt files are git-owned + NEVER_PUSH: apply via clone-and-push, then cp curmudgeon.md to the FUSE workspace (prompt sync gotcha) or wait for dome-mirror. Expected post-apply signature: curmudgeon-authored commit ~01:15 UTC daily, cost-history rows resume, decider daily report starts processing same-day reviews.
